correspondence.evidence: Histories retains activation stopping, positive/negative oracle branches, and every augmented route action in a dependent pair; bias and outside remain distinct despite sharing terminal values. probability uses the controlling player policy and a fair sign oracle.

pathReturn multiplies child returns by 2alpha/2beta on entry from activation into positive/negative routing states. Routing moves add no second multiplier. forcedReturn does the same for the ungated readout.

Negative branches replace q by !q, while the ordinary path parity is xor q r. Source true means positive player ownership; BackwardGames false means unchanged parity. The final recovery starts at true and subtracts false-owner endpoints.

inputLayerGames splits the actual signed products x_i W_ji, with constant signed-unit terminal children; hidden layerGames requires nonnegative values and splits the weights before multiplying by those values.

Canonical gate is exactly decide(0 < preactivation), inherited from chosenLogAction. Zero sign streams select outside; normalization is retained while ordinary entries use totalized zero division. Epsilon is allowed to be zero.

RoutingHistorySteps explicitly sums full-history fibers, integrates each arbitrary continuation using probability_normalized, and composes the first-microstep projection with ordinary/cemetery target projection. This is a derived finite pushforward, not an assumption of the macro row.

networkOccupation is a full-history integral with concrete input-owner marks, not a definition in terms of a derivative or rgOccupation. network_integral derives trace propagation from actual routing/activation integrals; traceObservation_kernels connects it to the independently defined parity matrices.

intermediateOccupation marks roots of the actual prefix game trees and keeps their full continuations in Histories. integral_root integrates those normalized continuations. networkGame_append_layer identifies the composed tree with the appended source network.

ForcedHistories is a sum of complete positive/negative routing histories with no stop/continue gate. The output can have negative or zero logit. The explicit hypothesis net.eval x >= 0 matches hidden activation routing and excludes signed raw identity outputs unless nonnegative.

boundaries_to_preserve: Layered shared Network backbone, with nonempty activated prefix for the supplied intermediate-cut corollary; no general residual/maxpool routing-DAG theorem is claimed.
Canonical anchor theta=1 for probability/backward equivalence. Arbitrary-profile history normalization is separate from the already frozen SPNE result.
The ordinary-policy product theorem is not alone a full stopped-history law equivalence. Complete-history marginal and integral theorems provide distinct statements.
All identities allow real alpha,beta. Nonnegative discounted occupations require alpha,beta nonnegative; discounted occupation need not have total mass one.
Readout backbone activations must be nonnegative; the final affine output is ungated and may be signed.
No compile, exact-type or axiom success is inferred from these draft sources or the finite experiment.
